e-n-accordion-item-2420: 选择 SMAS 面部提升或深层平面扩展面部提升取决于面部衰老程度和期望效果。SMAS 面部提升适合希望改善中度下垂、获得自然效果并强化下颌线和颈部轮廓的人。深层平面扩展提升更适合面部衰老较严重的人，因为它可对中面部、面颊、下颌线和颈部进行全面提升，效果更显著且持久。咨询合格整形外科医生以确定最适合您的手术方法非常重要。
The SMAS facelift is ideal for individuals seeking to address moderate sagging and achieve natural results with enhanced jawline and neck definition.

The Extended Deep Plane facelift is better suited for those with more advanced facial aging, as it offers comprehensive rejuvenation of the mid-face, cheeks, jawline, and neck, resulting in more dramatic and longer-lasting results.
Consulting with a qualified plastic surgeon is essential to determine which technique is best suited to your needs.
